reason: I do 1-6 homes a year and the plans are usually still moving. If it shows something we won't build, I've got a client upset over a render I put my name on. My architects already hand me drawings, and $1,500 a plan is real money on a cost-plus job when I'm not sure the client even wants it.
objection: Will it actually match the plans? What if it shows finishes or details we won't build and the client holds me to it?
would_change_my_mind: A free sample of one of my actual plans that I can check line by line against the drawings, plus a clear statement that it's illustrative only, and a bulk per-plan price for the website walkthroughs well under $1,500.
